description.value: Ottavio Italian Bakery & Delicatessen has been a fixture of the Oak Bay neighbourhood since 1997, serving house-baked breads, artisan cheeses, Illy espresso, and a creative menu of grilled and cold panini on housemade focaccia. Cyclists can settle in at the licensed terrazzo patio or the bustling interior café, and the deli counter stocks Italian meats, cheeses, and imported goods for self-provisioning. A monthly Cheese Club and full catering service round out this beloved community institution.

address.value: 2272 Oak Bay Ave, Victoria, British Columbia V8R 1G7

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 27m; rack at 85m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and confirms this is a real, active business at 2272 Oak Bay Ave Victoria since 1997. Phone (250) 592-4080 and address match OSM exactly. The café menu page references a 'licensed terrazzo' (outdoor patio) but makes no explicit mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or Wi-Fi; DoorDash and deli pickup ordering confirm takeout, and the deli pickup service (breads, cheeses, meats ordered in advance) constitutes a packed lunch offering. Vegetarian menu items are clearly present across multiple categories (PRIMAVERA, VERDURA, BURRATA & TOMATO, YOGURT BOWL, etc.).
